name: Template Filtered Target Spell
displayText: Deal 3 damage to a damaged enemy unit that costs 4 or less.

text.summary: Finishes off a wounded enemy unit.
notes: Because the target is required and filtered, this spell cannot be played at all when no enemy unit matches. The engine works that out; the client only shows the result.
Amounts are fixed numbers. There is no variable-value expression in the schema yet — a card whose damage depends on the board needs engine work, not just data.
